name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A row of slides that scrolls and snaps, built from CSS alone.
use: A few items of the same kind that a reader moves through one at a time or a few at a time: projects, team members, screenshots. It never moves by itself.

instead.when: The row moves by itself and a reader loses nothing by missing an item
The region scrolls freely and nothing in it snaps

keyboard.action: Scroll the focused track, as any scroll container does
Moves to the track, and to the previous and next buttons and the dots where the browser generates them
Activates a generated button or dot

platform.fallback: No buttons and no dots: the carousel is a row that swipes, scrolls and snaps

classes.name: carousel
classes.description: The scrolling, snapping track. Give it role="region", a label and tabindex="0" so the arrow keys can scroll it

classes.name: carousel-slide
classes.description: A slide: it snaps to the start of the track and takes --carousel-slide of its width

states.name: in view
states.description: On the slide's ::scroll-marker: the dot of the slide in view lengthens and takes ink

properties.name: --carousel-slide
properties.description: Width of a slide; set any width for a slide that peeks

properties.name: --carousel-control
properties.description: Size of the previous and next buttons
